name: Davriel Cane
description: A planeswalker who enjoys wealth, luxury and fine tea and is a talented diabolist skilled at binding demons to his service.

description_citations.text: "Davriel Cane". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Davriel Cane fights off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind.
timeline.quote: Davriel Cane was able to fight off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind

citation.text: "Elderspell", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel frees Isona, who dampens Tezzeret's aether connection, and planeswalkers leave him a statue.
timeline.quote: They left him as a statue in his laboratory

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt is lured to Ravnica and trapped; he fights the Eternals while tormenting civilians and leads demons and devils with Davriel Cane.
timeline.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the diabolist Davriel Cane .

citation.text: "Tibalt", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda attacks the Lord of the Manor, Davriel, with a rusty pick; he brushes it off and agrees to help her.
timeline.quote: attempted to kill him with a rusty pick

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "Meeting Davriel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda and Davriel investigate and deduce the Whisperers came from the Bog and that a betrayer had let the geists into the church.
timeline.quote: Davriel reasoned that they were from the Bog

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity; the Bog is found empty and Whisperers besiege them.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Priory, they discover Willia is alive and the key actor in the conflict.
timeline.quote: its major actor was none other than Tacenda's, thought to be deceased, sister Willia!

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda finds the dead Nameless Angel, learns a new joyful song, defeats the Whisperers and, with Davriel, kills Willia, making the Bog Entity whole inside her.
timeline.quote: the Bog Entity was made whole inside Tacenda

citation.text: "Tacenda Verlasen", section "The final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Willia is allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor.
timeline.quote: Willia was allegedly killed by the Lord of the Manor

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The coming of the Whisperers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda attacks the Lord of the Manor with a rusty pick; Davriel brushes it off and decides to help her.
timeline.quote: attempted to kill him with a rusty pick

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Meeting Davriel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda and Davriel reason that the Whisperers come from the Bog.
timeline.quote: Davriel reasoned that they were from the Bog

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity, but the Bog is empty and they are besieged by Whisperers.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Priory they discover Willia is alive and a major player in the conflict.
timeline.quote: none other than Tacenda's, thought to be deceased, sister Willia

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "Search for the truth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Davriel's help Tacenda overcomes and kills Willia, and the Bog Entity is made whole inside Tacenda.
timeline.quote: she also overcame and killed Willia

citation.text: "Children of the Nameless", section "The final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel steals the Entity by pulling it from the mind of a dying man, becoming hunted by the man's allies.
timeline.quote: Ever since stealing the Entity — pulling it from the mind of a dying man — Davriel had been able to sense its vast potential.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel draws on the Entity once, destroying both armies in a struggle to claim a throne.
timeline.quote: Davriel had used the power of the Entity only once, three years before his arrival on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel flees after sensing hunters drawn by his use of the Entity.
timeline.quote: And so he fled.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel moves to Innistrad's Approaches and removes the previous ruler, Lord Vaast.
timeline.quote: He moved to the backwater of the Approaches - the most remote location on an already remote plane - and immediately removed the previous ruler, a vampire known as Lord Vaast of the Markov line.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Verlasen is attacked by geists and Tacenda blames Davriel.
timeline.quote: Davriel was caught up in local events when the citizens of Verlasen were attacked by geists , and the girl Tacenda blamed him for orchestrating that attack.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel decides to help Tacenda find the impostor and restore the villagers' souls.
timeline.quote: Wanting to restore his peace, Davriel decided to help Tacenda find the imposter and restore the souls of the villagers to their stiffened bodies.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hunters and cathars from Thraben attack at the church, killing Davriel's demons Brerig and Yledris.
timeline.quote: a group of hunters and cathars from Thraben attacked the group, killing Davriel's demons Brerig and Yledris.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity.
timeline.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Investigating the Bog, they find it empty and are besieged by Whisperers controlled by Willia.
timeline.quote: they were besieged by a host of Whisperers under the control of Tacenda's twin sister Willia .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Davriel's help Tacenda kills Willia and the Bog Entity is made whole inside her.
timeline.quote: With the help of Davriel, she also overcame and killed Willia.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel refuses to seize Tacenda's power as his Entity urges.
timeline.quote: Unwilling to become a creature that only caused death and destruction, Davriel refused to do it.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel's Entity proclaims him unworthy and threatens to find another host.
timeline.quote: After Davriel refused to absorb the power of the second Entity, his own Entity proclaimed him unworthy and threatened to find another host.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Davriel's Entity". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel is visited by a group of planeswalkers, possibly the Gatewatch, seeking to recruit him.
timeline.quote: He was soon visited by a group of planeswalkers (possibly the Gatewatch ) looking to recruit him to their cause.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel is lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Davriel was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon , and immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel leads an army of demons and devils alongside Tibalt against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the half- devil Tibalt .

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel steals the Elderspell from an Eternal's mind.
timeline.quote: He also fought off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind (which may enable him to cast it himself).

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel escapes Ravnica once Chandra disables the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Davriel survived the battle, as he was one of the many planeswalkers who left Ravnica and escaped to safety as soon as Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tacenda finds the dead Nameless Angel, learns a new song, defeats the Whisperers and, with Davriel Cane, kills Willia; the Entity is whole in Tacenda.
timeline.quote: With help of Davriel Cane , she also overcame and killed Willia.

citation.text: "Entity of the Bog", section "Reformed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Davriel often finds himself in the hero's role despite detesting it and trying to avoid it.
timeline.quote: He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.

citation.text: "Davriel Cane". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Davriel Cane spends time in Vex and obtains a shadow charm.
timeline.quote: a place of demons where Davriel Cane spent some time, and from where he obtained a shadow charm.

citation.text: "Places of unknown origin", section "Places". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
